headline: Why Did Philip Morris (PM) Rise After Cutting Its 2026 Profit Forecast Again?
summary: Philip Morris International Inc. (NYSE:PM) cut its 2026 adjusted earnings forecast for the third time this year on July 22. Nevertheless, the shares rose about 5% in early trading and closed 3.33% higher at $194.30. The market appears to have looked through the guidance reduction for two reasons. headline: PMI U.S. Opens $1.2 Billion Aurora Campus, Strengthening U.S. Manufacturing and Export Capabilities
summary: STAMFORD, CT, July 27, 2026--Philip Morris International Inc.’s (PMI) (NYSE: PM) U.S. businesses (PMI U.S.) today celebrated the opening of its Aurora, Colorado manufacturing campus, a landmark investment representing total capital expenditures of $1.2 billion from 2024-2028.
